pr_title: feat(test runner): update scheduling logic to avoid unneeded stalls
pr_body:
In some circumstances, dispatcher was waiting for all existing jobs
to finish before scheduling a new one. This leads to unneeded stalls.
Instead, we can schedule jobs right away, if we have a worker
available.

Fixes #9609.

issue_context.title: [BUG] Parallel execution with more than 1 worker, new context for failed test case is created only after other workers succeed.
